item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of crisis containment, alliance management, and institutional repair, but not much evidence of coercive repression or dramatic purges. The main mode of “managing resistance” was reform, coalition bargaining, and eventual withdrawal, not hard crackdown. So the best reading is: Kishida preserved objectives and influence fairly well internationally and administratively, but domestic durability was only partially maintained, and by late 2024 the strain was too high to sustain him in office.","evidence":[{"title":"Emergency response to the Noto earthquake","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"2024-01-01","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/decisions/2024/0101shiji.html","summary":"Kishida ordered timely warnings, evacuation, damage prevention, and emergency response with human life first. This is a classic regime-preservation move: he absorbed scandal pressure, reset the narrative, and used institutional reform to keep the broader program alive.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","8B.6","8B.5"]},{"title":"Funding reform follow-through","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202406/21kaiken.html","summary":"Kishida said restoring trust in politics was the main issue, noted that he disbanded his faction, and reported amendments to the Political Funds Control Act plus plans for a third-party inspections-and-audits body. This is strong evidence of adapting to institutional resistance and trying to preserve governing capacity after scandal.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","8B.4","8B.5"]},{"title":"Diet session results","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202407/03sei_yoto.html","summary":"Kishida reported that nearly all bills and treaties passed, including the Political Funds Control Act, child-care support, and agriculture legislation. This shows him preserving and expanding international influence through alliance management, even as it hardened bloc competition.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.2","8B.3"]},{"title":"Iran-Israel de-escalation","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan","date":"2024-04-15","url":"https://www.mofa.go.jp/ecm/ec/pageit_000001_00279.html","summary":"Kishida urged self-restraint after Iran’s attack on Israel and said Japan would protect and evacuate citizens.
